name: Alexa AI
tagline: Alexa AI is Amazon's voice-based personal assistant, available on Echo devices, smartphones, and third-party hardware. It handles voice commands for smart home control, music playback, shopping, reminders, and general knowledge queries, with a growing set of generative AI capabilities.
